### 2026-10-08 – (10/07/26) Starbie's schematic and PCB design, check!

**4h**

(10/07/26) Starbie's schematic and PCB design, check!

### 2026-10-09 – (10/08/26) Starbie's Firmware and Repo Updates!

**2h**

(10/08/26) Starbie's Firmware and Repo Updates!

Finally figured out how to modify the code in the firmware file, added a custom cat sprite for the digital pet using Aseprite and image2cpp to make it a bitmap and modified the code for it to fit my cat's preferred actions and reactions(Most actions give increased hunger now). Also, had to reverse the SDA and SCL pins since they didn't match my schematic's ESP32-C3 pins.

(October 8)
